subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 369 (NYM-3). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). From MT-INFO: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and STF (source transfer). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is on a dotted line from MT-INFO. From PROJ-CONT: SI (source initiation) and LK-IMP (linkage implications), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". ROTP (responsibility of the position), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", is on a dotted line from PROJ-CONT. From LK-IMP: C-INFO (composite information) and MT-INFO.
